# Qualification vendor provenance

Based on crates.io `monstertruck-modeling 0.4.1`, archive SHA-256 `518f0c01eb240558e830d6734ab88dc0bf559923811553302aa1f3c16051c211`, Apache-2.0; upstream commit `e6520c2b1bde6f46a85649024663583cd03f484c`. All 51 registry-base file hashes were verified before copying; cache metadata and nested Cargo.lock are omitted.

The reviewed local change in `src/geometry/surface.rs` validates the represented intersection curve instead of its approximate leader. Frozen patch SHA-256 `541d920fe810c7bbb9d2f4029d36fd5c9b66a6bcc8cd8e9837e4c1df0ca12ef0`; evidence and independent reviews are under `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/dish-face-division-v1/` and `dish-projection-{spec,standards}-review/`. This remains sampled containment; active-domain padding handling is a separate open correction.

Containment-v24 restricts that sampling schedule to the represented curve active interval, explicitly including both endpoints and rejecting nonfinite/nonpositive domains. Reviewed production patch `c44d1e6f965f9e209465f1d827fec333f6f97620577d9e8e44456f57a335ecea` and regression patch `07eb06587ef396079f2e5030f9d35af4a98bf0888cb168743bcf1d0e6bba0575`; evidence: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/containment-active-domain-v1/` and its two independent review directories. Continuous containment remains unproved.

OEM-v29 checks the represented intersection curve on polynomial/rational patches instead of its approximate leader. It retains finite active target domains, the existing six-per-degree spline/two-per-degree analytic sampling policies, endpoints and tolerance. Reviewed candidate-v2 patch SHA256 `59a6835a28656ba34b55d9c0631fbfa171c6a05495b5aea1110fadc47657c876`; evidence: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/oem-cavity-diagnosis-v1/`. Actual OEM pre-dish cavity checks pass; this sampled predicate does not establish continuous containment or full OEM dish/material parity. Generic Cut and unclamped boundary inverse gaps remain separate.

Plane-v40 forwards the actual surface variant's exact affine-plane certificate. Reviewed v3 full patch SHA256 `a4c879d1964a93a04a9e98d282dc20ed5a9a04c12d52f811ba6667b5abd00157`; source and compatibility boundary: `.evidence/monstertruck-qualification/plane-source-transform-v3/primitive-freeze-v1/`. This capability does not certify arbitrary intersection curves or material orientation.

Native revolution frame correction (v47): `Surface::include` inverse-transforms the query curve into the native revolution Processor frame, rejecting nonfinite/singular frames before existing support dispatch. No public API, support tolerance or other surface algorithm changes. Reviewed production patch SHA256 `1b833d494313485d58807b7f1dd2f9944925ce7d1f9bf08d2f99ed3f596be8cf`; evidence `.evidence/layered-case-013/builder/v4/native-revolution/` and independent `native-revolution-{spec,standards}-review/`. Public regression tests are retained in `cad/monstertruck/tests/native_revolution_frame.rs`. This does not qualify general continuous containment or full layered production adoption.
